description: This file defines a JavaScript module named aclviewer, which provides functions for managing access control roles in the SuiteCRM user interface. It includes methods for viewing, saving, toggling display of UI elements, and handling AJAX requests related to ACL role management.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Initiates an AJAX request to load role data for a specific role and module, then displays it upon success.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Sends form data via AJAX to save ACL role changes and triggers post-save handling.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Handles the response after saving, updates the UI with new role data.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the response content related to ACL roles in the page, updating inner HTML.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles AJAX failures by showing an error message.

methods.name: toggleDisplay
methods.description: Shows or hides a specific UI element based on current display state.
